title: "I Wrote, I Paused, I Rewrote": A Mixed-Methods Study of Learner Perceptions of Process-Aware LLM Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.00009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models increasingly provide formative writing feedback, but most systems evaluate only the submitted text. Process-aware systems can additionally incorporate intermediate drafts and interaction records, yet access to these traces does not establish whether learners perceive the resulting feedback as useful, fair, or aligned with their own revision experience. We conducted a convergent mixed-method post-task evaluation with 43 undergraduate English-language learners. Participants completed a timed essay, received LLM-generated feedback based on the final essay, intermediate snapshots, and keystroke-derived records, and then answered six five-point Likert items and four open-ended questions.   Ratings were concentrated above the neutral midpoint across all six items. Between 74.4% and 95.3% of participants selected ratings of 4 or 5, and all six one-sided exact sign tests remained significant after Holm correction. Perceiv

translated_title: 《“我写了，我停顿了，我重写了”：学习者对过程感知型大语言模型反馈感知的混合方法研究》
translated_abstract: 大语言模型日益被用于提供写作形成性反馈，但大多数系统仅评估最终提交的文本。过程感知系统还可以纳入中间草稿和交互记录，然而获取这些痕迹并不能确定学习者是否认为由此产生的反馈有用、公平，或与其自身的修改经历相符。我们对43名本科生英语学习者进行了一项聚合式混合方法任务后评估。参与者完成一篇限时作文，接收基于最终作文、中间快照和按键记录生成的大语言模型反馈，然后回答六个五点李克特量表题目和四个开放式问题。在所有六个题目上，评分均集中在高于中性中点的区间。74.4%至95.3%的参与者选择了4或5的评分，且经Holm校正后，所有六个单侧精确符号检验均保持显著。
tldr: 通过对43名本科生英语学习者的混合方法研究，发现学习者对基于写作过程（中间草稿、快照及按键记录）生成的大语言模型反馈持积极评价，认为其有用且与自身修改经历相符。
en_tdlr: A mixed-methods study with 43 undergraduate English learners shows that learners perceive process-aware LLM feedback—based on intermediate drafts and keystroke records—as useful, fair, and aligned with their own revision experience.
